observations: Black Sony PS4 Pro console with characteristic three-tier design.
Two DualShock 4 controllers: one grey camouflage pattern and one solid black.
Front of the console displays 'SONY' and 'PS4' branding.
A red and white warning sticker is visible on the top right of the console.
The console is stacked on top of other console shells or units in a retail-like environment.
Watermark 'RICHARD IHEYI' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' present on both photos.

claims.evidence: Missing screenshot of System Storage settings.
Missing photo of the console home screen or library.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: Video showing the console successfully logging into the PSN store.

risks.risk: Installed games may be tied to a seller's account that will be removed after sale.
risks.proof: Confirmation that games are physical discs or that the account is included.

risks.risk: Controllers may have 'stick drift' or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: Video of both controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: Internal fan may be excessively loud due to dust or dried thermal paste.
risks.proof: Video with sound of the console running a demanding game for 5 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring professional cleaning and servicing

proof_requests: Screenshot of 'Settings > System > System Information' to verify storage and software version.
Photo of the console turned on showing the installed games.
Video of the console reading a physical game disc.
Video showing the console connecting to the internet and PlayStation Store.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PS4 Pro from the photos. While several functional claims are unverified, the item can be priced based on its worst-case functional state as a used unit.
